The climate in Sunny Beach

Sunny Beach is about 3 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 68 mm). The highest temperature in Sunny Beach in 2015–2024 was 37°C (18 July 2024) and the lowest −14°C (21 January 2017).

Sunny Beach is the largest resort on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast, with a beach of about 8 km on the bay of Nessebar. Summers are sunny and warm, and the sea is usually warm enough for swimming from June to mid-September. Winters are mild but windy, and the resort is then almost empty.

Best time to visit Sunny Beach

The most pleasant weather in Sunny Beach is usually in June and September: average highs are between 25°C and 26°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month.
